import { BattleFormatGui } from '@src/utils/battleMemoryMessage';
import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import App from '@src/response-apps/storyline/challenge/app';
import { displayCurrencyText } from '@src/constants/currency';
import { readBackendStorylineManualBattle, submitBackendStorylineManualChoice, type StorylineManualBattleState } from '@src/api/bot/storyline-manual-battle';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { addOptions, FormatGui, type GuiButton } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse, useSubscribe } from 'alemonjs';

type ParsedCommand = { chapterNumber: number; stageNumber: number } | { error: string } | null;
const parseCommand = (text: string): ParsedCommand => {
  const command = (text ?? '').trim().replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?\s*/, '');

  if (!command.startsWith('主线挑战')) {
    return null;
  }
  const match = command.match(/^主线挑战\s+(\d+)\s*[-－]\s*(\d+)$/);

  if (!match) {
    return { error: '格式错误，正确用法：/主线挑战 章-关（如 /主线挑战 1-1）' };
  }
  const chapterNumber = Number(match[1]),
    stageNumber = Number(match[2]);

  return Number.isSafeInteger(chapterNumber) && Number.isSafeInteger(stageNumber)
    ? { chapterNumber, stageNumber }
    : { error: '格式错误，正确用法：/主线挑战 章-关（如 /主线挑战 1-1）' };
};
const routeChoice = (text: string): string | null => {
  const command = text.trim().replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?\s*/, '');

  return (
    ({ 普攻: 'normal', 普通攻击: 'normal', 战技: 'battle', 神通: 'divine', 自动: '自动', 切换自动: '自动', 逃跑: '逃跑' } as Record<string, string>)[command] ??
    null
  );
};

export default onResponse(selects, e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const [subscribe] = useSubscribe(selects);
  const bid = String(e?.UserId ?? '');
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const parsed = parseCommand(e.MessageText ?? '');

  if (!parsed) {
    return;
  }
  if ('error' in parsed) {
    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '主线挑战', content: Format.createMarkdown().addText(parsed.error) }));

    return;
  }

  const render = async (state: StorylineManualBattleState) => {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    if (state.finished) {
      const settlement = (state.settlement ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
      const won = state.winner === 'A';
      const stageLabel = typeof settlement.stageLabel === 'string' ? settlement.stageLabel : '';
      const stars = typeof settlement.stars === 'number' ? settlement.stars : 0;
      const exp = typeof settlement.experienceGained === 'number' ? settlement.experienceGained : 0;
      const stones = typeof settlement.spiritStoneGained === 'number' ? settlement.spiritStoneGained : 0;
      const spiritCost = typeof settlement.spiritCostPaid === 'number' ? settlement.spiritCostPaid : 0;
      const monsterName = typeof settlement.monsterName === 'string' ? settlement.monsterName : '';
      const drops = Array.isArray(settlement.drops) ? settlement.drops : [];
      const chapterNumber = typeof settlement.chapterNumber === 'number' ? settlement.chapterNumber : 0;
      const stageNumber = typeof settlement.stageNumber === 'number' ? settlement.stageNumber : 0;
      const topRowButtons: GuiButton[] = [];
      const actionRowButtons: GuiButton[] = [];

      if (settlement.teamId) {
        md.addNewline();
        md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('📢 仅队长消耗精力与结算奖励，队友不消耗不结算'));
      }
      md.addNewline();
      const battleRounds = (settlement.battle as { Rounds?: unknown } | undefined)?.Rounds;
      const outcome = Format.createMarkdown()
        .addText(`对手：${monsterName}`)
        .addNewline()
        .addText(`结果：${won ? '胜利' : '失败'}`);

      if (typeof battleRounds === 'number') {
        outcome.addNewline().addText(`回合数：${battleRounds}`);
      }
      md.addBlockquote(outcome.addNewline().addText(`消耗精力：${spiritCost}`));
      if (won) {
        md.addBlockquote(
          Format.createMarkdown()
            .addText(`星级评价：${'⭐'.repeat(stars)}${'☆'.repeat(Math.max(0, 3 - stars))}`)
            .addNewline()
            .addText(`修为获得：+${exp}${typeof settlement.expBonusText === 'string' ? settlement.expBonusText : ''}`)
        );
        if (stones > 0) {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`灵石获得：+${stones}`));
        }
      }
      if (won && drops.length > 0) {
        md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('额外掉落：'));
        for (const value of drops) {
          const drop = value as { name?: unknown; amount?: unknown; itemId?: unknown; currencyCode?: unknown };

          if (typeof drop.amount === 'number') {
            const line = Format.createMarkdown().addText(
              `${typeof drop.name === 'string' ? displayCurrencyText(drop.name) : typeof drop.currencyCode === 'string' ? displayCurrencyText(drop.currencyCode) : '奖励'}×${drop.amount} `
            );

            md.addBlockquote(typeof drop.itemId === 'number' ? addOptions(line, [{ label: '详情', command: `/物品详情 道具 ${drop.itemId}` }]) : line);
          }
        }
      }
      if (state.logId) {
        topRowButtons.push({ label: '文字记录', command: `/查看战斗过程 ${state.logId}` });
      }
      if (chapterNumber > 0) {
        topRowButtons.push({ label: '打开章节', command: `/查看主线 ${chapterNumber}` });
      }
      if (chapterNumber > 0 && stageNumber > 0) {
        if (settlement.showPrevStage === true) {
          actionRowButtons.push({ label: '上一关', command: `/主线挑战 ${chapterNumber}-${stageNumber - 1}` });
        }
        actionRowButtons.push({ label: '再次挑战', command: `/主线挑战 ${chapterNumber}-${stageNumber}` });
        if (settlement.showNextStage === true) {
          actionRowButtons.push({ label: '下一关', command: `/主线挑战 ${chapterNumber}-${stageNumber + 1}` });
        } else if (settlement.showNextChapter === true) {
          actionRowButtons.push({ label: '下一章', command: `/查看主线 ${chapterNumber + 1}` });
        }
      }
      void message.send(
        await BattleFormatGui(
          {
            isPrivate,
            bid,
            title: `主线结算 ${stageLabel}`,
            content: md,
            footer: [topRowButtons, actionRowButtons].filter(row => row.length > 0)
          },
          [{ id: state.logId }]
        )
      );

      return;
    }
    if (!state.choice) {
      return;
    }
    for (const event of state.events) {
      const row = event as { actorName?: string; skillName?: string };

      if (row.actorName || row.skillName) {
        md.addText(`${row.actorName ?? '单位'} 使用 ${row.skillName ?? '技能'}\n`);
      }
    }
    md.addText(`第${state.choice.round}回合：${state.choice.unitName}请选择技能\n`);
    for (const skill of state.choice.availableSkills) {
      md.addText(`${skill.available ? '✅' : '⬜'} ${skill.name || skill.type}${skill.reason ? `（${skill.reason}）` : ''}\n`);
    }
    md.addText('回复：普攻 / 战技 / 神通 / 自动 / 逃跑');
    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '主线挑战', content: md }));
    let handled = false;
    let refresh: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
    const pollSettlement = () => {
      if (handled) {
        return;
      }
      void readBackendStorylineManualBattle(bid, uid, state.sessionId)
        .then(next => {
          if (handled) {
            return;
          }
          if (next.finished) {
            handled = true;
            subscribe.cancel(subscription);

            return render(next);
          } else {
            refresh = setTimeout(pollSettlement, 3_000);
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {
          if (!handled) {
            refresh = setTimeout(pollSettlement, 3_000);
          }
        });
    };

    refresh = setTimeout(pollSettlement, 31_000);
    const subscription = subscribe.mount(
      (event: any) => {
        const choice = routeChoice(String(event.MessageText ?? ''));

        if (!choice) {
          return;
        }
        handled = true;
        clearTimeout(refresh);
        subscribe.cancel(subscription);
        void submitBackendStorylineManualChoice(bid, uid, state.sessionId, choice, createBackendRequestContext(event))
          .then(render)
          .catch(error => {
            // Invalid or expired choices are explained by Go. Read its current
            // projection before accepting another reply so the robot never
            // restores a stale local choice list.
            void readBackendStorylineManualBattle(bid, uid, state.sessionId)
              .then(render)
              .catch(() => {
                void message.send(
                  FormatGui({
                    isPrivate,
                    bid,
                    title: '主线挑战',
                    content: Format.createMarkdown().addText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '技能提交失败')
                  })
                );
              });
          });
      },
      ['UserId']
    );
  };

  void App({ bid, uid, ...parsed, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) }).then(result => {
    if (result.code === 'OK') {
      return render(result.data);
    } else {
      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '主线挑战', content: Format.createMarkdown().addText(result.data.message) }));
    }
  });
});
